title: She Had 60 Days Or Leave The UK
description:
If your UK visa is running out and you're panicking about applications, this is the exact system one of my students used to go from being made redundant with 60 days left on her skilled worker visa to landing a £57,000 offer. Before her Home Office letter even arrived.

In this video I break down the four step visa sponsorship system that works for any international candidate in the UK. Personal branding, targeting the right 808 companies, networking instead of applying, and how to handle the visa conversation in interviews without killing the deal.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Vimbai had 60 days left on her UK visa
0:22 Why most international candidates get ghosted
2:01 Step 1: Build a personal brand that overrides the visa objection
3:06 Step 2: The 808 UK visa sponsors nobody applies to
4:09 Step 3: The LATR networking system (stop applying)
5:57 Step 4: How to control the visa conversation in interviews
6:55 The £57k offer (before her Home Office letter arrived)
7:23 What to do if your visa clock is ticking right now

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
